name: io.github.nick353/jp-business-id
title: Japan Business ID
description: Validate Japanese invoice registration numbers (T+13) and corporate numbers. No API key.

tools.name: validate_invoice_number
tools.description: Check a Japanese qualified invoice registration number (適格請求書発行事業者登録番号, "T" + 13 digits) for format and check digit, tell whether it is a corporation's number, and return the official lookup URL. Accepts full-width characters and hyphens.

tools.name: validate_corporate_number
tools.description: Check a Japanese corporate number (法人番号, 13 digits) with the National Tax Agency check digit formula; on a typo, return the expected check digit. Returns the official lookup URL.

tools.name: corporate_number_from_base
tools.description: Build the 13-digit corporate number (法人番号) from a 12-digit company registry number (会社法人等番号) by computing the check digit.

tools.name: extract_business_ids
tools.description: Find and validate invoice registration numbers and corporate numbers inside invoice, receipt or contract text (up to 20,000 characters).
